correctness.rationale: A zero-sum gradient ODE gives a direct Dini variation derivative. Uniform flux monotonicity gives sufficiency. For n>=6, disjoint distance-three dipoles imply d_j+d_{j+3}<=0; cyclic summation forces equality; superquadratic perturbations isolate d_j and force all d_j=0. For n<=5, equality in unweighted dissipation would require opposite nonzero increments at graph distance at least three, impossible; compactness gives a neighborhood of contractive anisotropic weights. Complete 30-chamber p=3 five-cycle and 62-chamber p=2 six-cycle certificates are exact rational calculations, verified in the included program.

value.rationale: A sharp length-five/six dichotomy for nonlinear cycle heat valid for all p>2, with exact anisotropic five-cycle witness and immediate amplification on every longer nonuniform cycle. This describes a structural loss of anisotropic stability that differs from linear p=2 and from standard vertex contraction, rather than an arbitrary finite calculation.
